class.name: FmodSoundLock
class.brief_description: Locks sound sample data and exposes copies for reading.
class.description: FmodSoundLock locks a region of sound data and copies its contents into [PackedByteArray] values returned by [method get_data1] and [method get_data2]. Editing these arrays does not write back to the sound. A locked region can have two portions if it wraps around the end of the sound buffer. Keep the source [FmodSound] alive until [method unlock] is called. The lock stores a native pointer and does not retain the sound wrapper. Call [method unlock] when finished. Destroying the lock object also unlocks the region.

method.name: unlock
method.description: Unlocks the sound data, allowing FMOD to resume normal processing. This should be called as soon as you're finished accessing the data. The destructor automatically calls this if the data is still locked.

method.name: get_data1
method.description: Returns a copy of the first portion of the locked data. Returns an empty array after unlocking. Editing the returned array does not modify the sound.

method.name: get_data2
method.description: Returns a copy of the second portion of the locked data, which is present only when the region wraps around the end of the sound buffer. Returns an empty array after unlocking. Editing the returned array does not modify the sound.

method.name: is_locked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the sound data is currently locked and accessible.
